context_for_next_testing_agent: Voice Commands for Encounter Mode fully tested. Key endpoint: POST /api/encounters/{id}/mark-violation accepts form data with 'timestamp' (float) and 'note' (string) fields. Returns {success: true, mark: {mark_id, timestamp_seconds, note, created_at, source}}. Source is 'voice_command' if note contains 'voice', otherwise 'manual'. Marks are stored in encounter_marks collection and embedded in encounters.manual_marks array. Frontend Voice Commands UI panel appears during recording with toggle switch (data-testid='voice-commands-toggle'), available commands hint, and feedback display. Voice recognition uses Web Speech API which may not work in headless browsers.
